critique: Motion is now clearly present: frame 4 has rotated into a substantially different swept/twisted configuration from frame 1. The lime-on-black line treatment and dense streaklet layering read correctly. However, the visible structure is dominated by very long, broad arcs that run off both sides of frame; the actual twist/curl is small and pushed toward the left edge in frame 4. A Streaklet Twist preset should retain a more compact, legible twisted focal mass within the frame rather than reading primarily as cropped parallel ribbons.

suggestions.why: Reduce the excessive horizontal extent so more of the streaklet curl and crossing structure remains visible as a centered, readable twist instead of exiting the frame as long broad arcs.
